title_en: Great Poems and Songs (14/20): Ah Bing and "The Moon Reflected in Second Spring"
note_en: 被 marks the passive: 二泉映月被录了音 "the piece was recorded." The doer can follow 被 directly, as in 都被他写进了音乐里 "were all put into music by him," or be left out entirely. Unlike English "by," the doer comes before the verb, not after it.
